functions.name: RevertMove
functions.docs: Revert movement to the initial location of the Component at the start of the scoped update. Also clears pending overlaps and sets bHasMoved to false.

functions.name: IsTransformDirty
functions.docs: Returns true if the Component's transform differs from that at the start of the scoped update.

functions.name: AppendOverlapsAfterMove
functions.signature: AppendOverlapsAfterMove(Target, New Pending Overlaps, Sweep, Includes Overlaps At End)
functions.docs: Add overlaps to the queued overlaps array. This is intended for use only by SceneComponent and its derived classes whenever movement is performed.

functions.name: GetOuterDeferredScope
functions.docs: Get the scope containing this scope. A scope only has an outer scope if they both defer updates.

functions.name: IsDeferringUpdates
functions.docs: Return true if deferring updates, false if updates are applied immediately.

functions.name: IsGroupUpdate
functions.docs: Return true if this movement update should be deferred and applied later in the frame as part of a larger group of components.

functions.name: HasMoved
functions.docs: Returns whether movement has occurred at all during this scope, optionally checking if the transform is different (since changing scale does not go through a move). RevertMove() sets this back to false.

functions.name: HasPendingOverlaps
functions.docs: Returns true if there are pending overlaps queued in this scope.

functions.name: RequiresOverlapsEventFlag
functions.docs:
Returns true if we require GetGenerateOverlapEvents() on both the moving object and the overlapped object to add them to the pending overlaps list.
These flags will still be required when dispatching calls to UpdateOverlaps(), but this allows some custom processing of queued overlaps that would be otherwise missed along the way.

functions.name: GetPendingOverlaps
functions.docs: Returns the pending overlaps within this scope.

functions.name: GetPendingBlockingHits
functions.docs: Returns the list of pending blocking hits, which will be used for notifications once the move is committed.

functions.name: AppendBlockingHitAfterMove
functions.docs: Add blocking hit that will get processed once the move is committed. This is intended for use only by SceneComponent and its derived classes.

functions.name: KeepCurrentOverlapsAfterRotation
functions.docs: Keep current pending overlaps after a move but make note that there was movement (just a symmetric rotation).

functions.name: InvalidateCurrentOverlaps
functions.docs: Clear overlap state at current location, we don't know what it is.

functions.name: ForceOverlapUpdate
functions.docs: Force full overlap update once this scope finishes.

functions.name: SetHasTeleported
functions.docs: Registers that this move is a teleport

functions.name: GetTeleportType
functions.docs: The type of teleport which this scoped move should use to determine overlaps.

functions.name: GetHasMoved
functions.docs: True if this scoped movement resulted in the component being moved

functions.name: GetFinalOverlapCandidatesIndex
functions.docs: If not INDEX_NONE, overlaps at this index and beyond in PendingOverlaps are at the final destination

functions.name: GetOverlapState
functions.docs: The current overlap state of this scoped move.

functions.name: GetInitialTransform
functions.docs: The initial transform when this scoped movement began.

functions.name: GetOwner
functions.docs: The owning scene component this scoped movement is modifying.
